"We demonstrate efficient light coupling into optically excited high-density metallic nanotip arrays fabricated from gold, enabling high local fields for ultrafast electron emission. The coupling benefits from plasmonic field enhancement at the apexes under femtosecond illumination. We discuss array periodicity and resonance conditions to optimize plasmon-mediated emission."
Keywords visible on page: photonics; ultrafast optics; plasmonics; nanostructures.
Materials mentioned: gold metallic nanotip arrays.
Conclusion from abstract: The article explicitly mentions 'plasmonic' and 'plasmon-' and studies gold metallic nanotip arrays.

Subsequent confirmations (steps 8 and 19) further highlighted the error, but the agent persisted in the misinterpretation.
